en.question: A Skill is being written to help Claude generate compliance reports. Which content makes it most effective?

options.text: A concise one-line instruction telling Claude to generate reports correctly.
options.note: Too vague to trigger reliably or to alter the output.

options.text: The full source code of the internal service that stores report submissions.
options.note: Implementation source is irrelevant to producing the report and wastes context.

options.text: The list of employees who are authorised to request a compliance report.
options.note: Authorisation is an access control concern enforced in the application.

options.text: Triggering context plus the procedure, required sections, rules, and examples.

en.explanation: A Skill needs a description precise enough to be selected at the right moment and body content concrete enough to change the output: steps, structure, rules, and an example to pattern-match.
